unlock.rule: Episodes after the first two of each series unlock with one prayer, forever.

series.title: In the Beginning
series.subtitle: Genesis, told by the people who were there

episodes.label: Part 1
episodes.title: The First Man Ever
episodes.hook: I was never a baby. I woke up a grown man, made out of dirt.
episodes.question: If God made you on purpose, what changes today?
episodes.prayer: God, You made me on purpose. Help me live like it today.

episodes.label: Part 2
episodes.title: The Snake
episodes.hook: A talking snake got us kicked out of paradise.
episodes.question: What did God do for them right before He sent them out? (Genesis 3:21)
episodes.prayer: Father, when I hide from You, call me out of hiding. Thank You for covering me.

episodes.label: Part 3
episodes.title: Cain and Abel
episodes.hook: I was the first dad ever. My first son killed my second.
episodes.question: Why did God accept Abel's offering and not Cain's?
episodes.prayer: Lord, rule over the anger in me before it rules over me.

episodes.label: Part 4
episodes.title: The Ark
episodes.hook: Every person alive today comes from the eight people on this boat.
episodes.question: Be honest: would you have gotten on?
episodes.prayer: God, give me the faith to obey before I see the rain.

episodes.label: Part 5
episodes.title: Babel
episodes.hook: I was building the tallest tower on earth. Then nobody could understand a word I said.
episodes.question: What are you building to make a name for yourself?
episodes.prayer: Lord, let me build for Your name, not mine.

episodes.label: Bonus
episodes.title: Noah's Group Chat
episodes.hook: The night before the flood, in Noah's group chat.
episodes.question: What would your group chat have said to Noah?
episodes.prayer: God, make me faithful even when everyone around me laughs.

series.title: Jonah
series.subtitle: Three days in a fish, and a furious prophet

episodes.label: Part 1
episodes.title: Three Days in a Fish
episodes.hook: A fish swallowed me, and honestly, it was my own fault.
episodes.question: Where are you running from God right now?
episodes.prayer: Lord, wherever I'm running from You, turn me around. Salvation belongs to You.

episodes.label: Part 2
episodes.title: Nineveh
episodes.hook: I warned a whole city it would be destroyed. God spared them. And I was furious.
episodes.question: Is there someone you don't want God to forgive?
episodes.prayer: Father, give me Your mercy for the people I'd rather see punished.

series.title: Outnumbered
series.subtitle: Old Testament heroes against impossible odds

episodes.label: Episode 1
episodes.title: Balaam's Donkey
episodes.hook: My donkey saw an angel with a sword three times. I didn't. Then she talked.
episodes.question: What is God using to get your attention?
episodes.prayer: Lord, open my eyes to what You're showing me.

episodes.label: Episode 2
episodes.title: Gideon's 300
episodes.hook: I had thirty-two thousand soldiers. God cut us down to three hundred. On purpose.
episodes.question: Feeling outnumbered? Maybe that's the point.
episodes.prayer: God, when I feel too small, let it be Your strength that wins.

episodes.label: Episode 3
episodes.title: Fire on Mount Carmel
episodes.hook: 450 prophets shouted all day at nothing. Then fire fell on a soaked altar.
episodes.question: Would you have poured the water?
episodes.prayer: Lord, You answer. Make me bold enough to trust You in front of everyone.

episodes.label: Episode 4
episodes.title: Seven Baths
episodes.hook: Syria's greatest general was told to wash in a muddy river seven times.
episodes.question: What's the simple thing you're too proud to do?
episodes.prayer: Father, humble my pride and help me simply obey.

episodes.label: Episode 5
episodes.title: The Fiery Furnace
episodes.hook: I threw three men into a furnace. Then I counted four.
episodes.question: Be honest: would you have bowed?
episodes.prayer: God, be with me in the fire, and keep me from bowing to anything but You.

episodes.label: Episode 6
episodes.title: The Lions' Den
episodes.hook: I threw my best man to the lions. Then I couldn't sleep.
episodes.question: Thirty days, or the lions. Would you have closed the window?
episodes.prayer: Lord, keep my window open to You, whatever it costs.

series.title: Eyewitnesses
series.subtitle: The New Testament, from the people who saw it

episodes.label: Episode 1
episodes.title: The Boy's Lunch
episodes.hook: My lunch fed over five thousand people. All I had was five loaves and two fish.
episodes.question: What's the smallest thing you've ever given God?
episodes.prayer: Jesus, here is my little. Take it and make it enough.

episodes.label: Episode 2
episodes.title: Walking on Water
episodes.hook: I walked on water. Then I saw the wind.
episodes.question: Would you have gotten out of the boat?
episodes.prayer: Jesus, keep my eyes on You, not the wind.

episodes.label: Episode 3
episodes.title: Dead for Four Days
episodes.hook: I was dead for four days. Now they want to kill me again.
episodes.question: What feels too dead for Jesus to raise?
episodes.prayer: Jesus, You are the resurrection and the life. Speak life into what feels dead in me.

episodes.label: Episode 4
episodes.title: If Bible People Had Phones
episodes.hook: If Bible people had phones…
episodes.question: Which one would you have filmed?
episodes.prayer: Lord, make me a witness to what You've done.

episodes.label: Episode 5
episodes.title: Rhoda at the Gate
episodes.hook: An angel broke Peter out of prison. Then I left him standing at the gate.
episodes.question: What if what you're praying for is already knocking?
episodes.prayer: God, help me believe You're answering, even before I see it.

episodes.label: Episode 6
episodes.title: Asleep in Church
episodes.hook: I fell asleep during a sermon. Three floors up.
episodes.question: When did God pick you up when you least expected it?
episodes.prayer: Lord, wake me up to You, and thank You for picking me up when I fall.
